literal_label_or_expression: Sort; hold Shift to sort by more than one column

handler_expression:
{(event) =>
                  onSelectionChange(
                    event.target.checked
                      ? [...selectedIds, rowId]
                      : selectedIds.filter((id) => id !== rowId),
                  )
                }
{event => { const file = event.currentTarget.files?.[0]; event.currentTarget.value = ""; void importFile(file, event.currentTarget); }}
